title: Haitian Times reports data of at least 100,000 Capital Bank customers on a data leak site
date_note: The Haitian Times page gives only its publication day, 26 November; it does not say when the files appeared.
geo_basis: The Haitian Times says the bank's branches are in the Port-au-Prince area and provincial cities; the pin is the capital, not a stated headquarters address
summary: The Haitian Times reports that files on a data leak site showed account information for at least 100,000 Capital Bank customers, and says six sources confirmed that the records matched their own. The paper says Capital Bank has not responded to its phone and email messages. It links the leak to an apparent cyberattack that halted operations in early October.
plain: A Haitian newspaper says data on at least 100,000 customers of Capital Bank in Haiti is publicly available on a leak site. The bank had not responded to the paper when it published.
exec: A newspaper reports account data of at least 100,000 customers of a Haitian bank is exposed; the bank had not responded.

evidence.quote: showed account information for at least 100,000 customers

validation.note: Only the Haitian Times, which says it found the files itself; Capital Bank had not responded as of that article (26 November).
